description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 04.01.2016 to 10.01.2016
reasoning: This gazette content is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that establishes new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges. It falls under the Legal/Regulatory category as it constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for international trade and customs operations, specifically exercising powers granted by existing legislation to modify financial regulations.
